products.name: Ether (ETHA Trust ETF) future

price_data.note: Covered in the universe from 2026-09-22 (roadmap item 3). Not yet traded by any strategy: @basis-hunter points at it but its unit-reconciliation gate refuses the pair while the ETHA share and the Kalshi ETH perp quote different units of the asset (see spec_fields_verified.lot). BTC is traded by @basis-hunter (Kalshi BTC perp vs MOEX BTC index future, lot 0.001 BTC per the official specification Appendix 1).

spec_fields_verified.exchange_evidence: ETZ6 (ETHA-12.26): ISS description UNIT=USD, ASSETCODE=ETHA, CONTRACTNAME="фьючерсный контракт на акции инвестиционного фонда ETHA Trust ETF"; open interest 485,868 contracts (2026-09-22)
spec_fields_verified.lot: 1 ETHA share per contract. IMPORTANT: the share is NOT one ETH - on 2026-09-23 the share traded at 21.05 USD while the MOEX Ethereum Index (MOEXETH) was 2,761 USD, i.e. one share holds ~0.76% of an ETH. The share-to-ETH ratio is not published in the ISS fields this engine uses, so the ETHA future must not be used in a cross-venue ETH basis until that ratio is verified from an official source; the strategy unit-reconciliation gate blocks it automatically (2026-09-23).
spec_fields_verified.note: The MOEX Ethereum Index futures (specification code ETH, MOEXETH index) were NOT found in the FORTS listing on 2026-09-22 (probed SECID patterns ETHU6/ETHZ6/ETHF7/ETU6, all absent). The competition therefore covers ether via the listed ETHA ETF futures; if MOEX lists the ETH index futures they will need their own verified registry entry before trading.
